title: Read sweep at counter zero
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $E$ inject the symbols of $\Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e$ embed the binary alphabet into $\Gamma$. For a binary input $x$, a configuration $c$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$, and a state $q$ such that $c$ is in state $q$, the read-sweep configuration of $c$ at counter zero equals its encoded configuration.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is an embedding of symbols and blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits
$c$ is a configuration on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$
$q$ is a state and $c$ is in state $q$
replaced:
If the source configuration $c$ is in state $q$ (in particular not halted), then the
read-sweep configuration of $c$ at counter $0$ coincides with the encoded configuration
of $c$.
